title: LagRadar
description: Real-time lag cause detector, identify what is causing lag right now.
body:
# LagRadar

**Real-Time Lag Cause Detector**

Find out exactly what’s causing lag on your server **in real-time**. LagRadar tracks entities, tile entities, redstone, hoppers, and more; giving you actionable insights instantly.

## Features
- **`/lag top`**; View top lag contributors.  
- Detect dense mob clusters (mob farms, stacked mobs).  
- Show heavily ticking chunks.  
- Track hoppers and redstone activity.  
- Automatic MSPT spike warnings.  
- Lightweight and optimized for live servers.

## Configuration
- MSPT warning threshold  
- Entity cluster size  
- Hopper and redstone tracking toggles  
- Chunk scan interval
